# BtnKit Task Outline & Design Notes

## Section Order & Structure

1. `Navbar`: Fixed dark header with brand logo, category anchors, and GitHub / Component Dock quick links.
2. `Hero`: Dark gradient banner introducing dark mode bootstrap buttons with stats and action triggers.
3. `SolidButtonsSection`: Showcase of solid primary, secondary, success, danger, warning, and info buttons across sizes.
4. `OutlineButtonsSection`: Elegant bordered and ghost buttons with hover fill transitions.
5. `SocialButtonsSection`: Brand-colored buttons with Lucide icons (GitHub, Twitter, Discord, etc.).
6. `TogglesAndCheckboxesSection`: Interactive switch toggles, pill checkboxes, and badge counters.
7. `Footer`: Dark minimal footer with copyright and mandatory `https://www.componentdock.com/` link.

## Fidelity Notes

- **Aesthetic:** Dark mode first (`#090d16` background) with neon accent glows (`indigo`, `emerald`, `rose`, `cyan`).
- **Typography:** Clean sans-serif with strong font weights for section titles.
- **Interactivity:** Every button component features hover elevation, scale feedback, and active states.
